name: check_virtual_lab_health
description: Check whether the Virtual Lab is healthy, and report how many synthetic cases it holds. Takes no input.

name: update_cohort
description: Adds, replaces or removes filters on the researcher's selected cohort, which then shows in the cohort dropdown. Use it when the researcher asks to change who is in the cohort, such as 'only Black patients' or 'drop the sex filter'. Give each field and value as the researcher said it; the tool matches them to the data and says if a value is ambiguous or unknown. op is 'set' (replaces any existing value on that field) or 'remove' (values are not needed). All changes in one call apply together or not at all. It never takes a cohort, and only reports the change.

changes.description: The changes to make, applied together.

field.description: The field, as the researcher said it, such as race, sex or ISS stage.

values.description: The values to match, as the researcher said them. Leave empty for remove.

name: show_oncomatrix
description: Shows which genes are most frequently mutated in the researcher's selected cohort, in OncoMatrix, with the number of cases and of samples with a mutation in the genes shown. Use it for questions such as 'which genes are most frequently mutated', 'top mutated genes' or 'show an OncoMatrix'. maxGenes is optional, for requests such as 'top 3'; it must be a whole number of 1 or more. It never takes a cohort, and only reports numbers; the chart is drawn for the researcher.

maxGenes.description: How many top genes to show, a whole number of 1 or more. Leave out for the default.

name: show_lollipop
description: Shows a Lollipop plot in ProteinPaint: where one gene's mutations fall along the protein, and how often each occurs in the researcher's selected cohort. Use it when the researcher asks for a lollipop plot, asks to use ProteinPaint, or asks where a gene's mutations fall on the protein, such as 'Show a lollipop plot for KRAS', 'Use ProteinPaint for KRAS' or 'Where do KRAS mutations fall on the protein?'. Give the gene as the researcher said it; aliases such as c-Myc resolve to MYC. The result reports samples, variants and the most frequent variants, or says the gene isn't in this dataset or has no mutations in the cohort. It never takes a cohort, and only reports numbers; the plot is drawn for the researcher.

gene.description: The gene, as the researcher said it, such as KRAS or c-Myc.

name: show_survival
description: Shows a Kaplan-Meier survival plot from the Correlation Plot tool for the researcher's selected cohort. Use it for survival analysis, Kaplan-Meier or overall survival, such as 'Using the Correlation Plot tool, perform Kaplan Meyer survival analysis to overlay CGS high-risk versus standard-risk' or 'Compare survival for high risk vs standard risk'. To compare groups, give compareBy. The result reports cases, deaths, censored cases, median survival and log-rank P-values, or says a comparison isn't available. It never takes a cohort, and only reports numbers; the plot is drawn for the researcher.

compareBy.description: What to split the curve by. One of: CGS risk, KRAS status, Sex, Race. Leave out for one curve.
